note: Aruba keeps the Kingdom's Caribbean list; nationals of the Schengen countries other than the Netherlands stay up to 180 days in any 365 there (Jamaicans, exempt for Curaçao only, need a visa, as the list has it).

sources.title: NetherlandsWorldwide (Government of the Netherlands), What are the requirements for travelling to the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom without a visa?
sources.said: If you are a national of a Schengen country other than the Netherlands, you may stay in Aruba for a maximum of 180 days in any 365-day period. You may stay in the other Caribbean parts of the Kingdom for a maximum of 90 days in a 180-day period.

sources.title: NetherlandsWorldwide (Government of the Netherlands), Do I need a visa for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom?
sources.said: Jamaica: Curaçao only. You do need a visa for the other Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
